Hi Michael / Priyom,

Thanks for the pilot quote. Procurement here at Stonehaven has reviewed the PO (attached) and we need to clarify a couple of things before we can issue the signed PO:

- Our treasury requires the ability to receive invoices in multiple tranches tied to a single master PO number (PO 4589). Can Redwood accept monthly or bi-weekly invoices that reference PO 4589 + a tranche line (e.g., 4589-01, 4589-02)?
- We also need the invoice header to contain our internal ledger fields (BU code, CC, project code). Is there a standard invoice template you can provide so our AP system can auto-map?
- Net terms: our standard is Net 60 for new vendors, but we can do Net 45 if the vendor accepts a two-day remittance window on large files. Is Net 60 acceptable?
- Remittance: Stonehaven uses a consolidated remittance advice for multi-tranche POs. Can Redwood provide a consolidated statement at month-end that lists the tranche-level invoices?

Attaching the draft PO for reference (STONEHAVEN_PO_4589.pdf). If you can send the invoice template we can check mapping with our ERP team. Would like to close this by end of week to keep the pilot start next month.

Best,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Stonehaven Capital

A few details and next steps:
- Invoice cadence: our billing engine normally issues one invoice per customer per month per billing account. We can produce bi-weekly invoices as a special billing cadence if you need them — this would be an exception to our default.
- PO format: please put the master PO in the invoice header and then include a "Tranche reference" field for line-level invoices (e.g., PO 4589 / Tranche 01). That maps cleanly to our ledger export.
- Ledger fields: attachable template included (invoice_schedule_template.xlsx). If you return it with sample codes we will validate mapping to BU/CC/Project.
- Net terms: our default enterprise term is Net 45. We can provisionally agree Net 60 for the pilot provided your AP team signs the vendor setup form and we obtain credit approval. If Stonehaven needs Net 60 as a firm term for the contract, we will need to flag that for Sales Ops and add it to the SOW amendment.

Next actions:
1) Elena: confirm whether you want monthly or bi-weekly invoice cadence for the pilot and return the filled invoice template.
2) Priyom/Vanessa: I am looping you for SOC/finance sign-off and for the amendment if Net 60 is requested.

We want to avoid any manual AR work for your team — if we can get the ERP codes we will pre-populate the invoice fields.

Hi Elena — quick operational clarifications from Sales Ops / Billing: 

- System constraint: Netsuite-based invoicing requires one AP-GL mapping per invoice file. Practically that means we can either (A) issue a single consolidated invoice each month that lists multiple tranche lines under the master PO, or (B) issue multiple smaller invoices (one per tranche) but each must include the master PO and the same remittance address. Both are supported; option (A) is preferred for your ERP to reduce lock-step remittance entries.
- Metadata required on each invoice: Invoice number, Invoice date, PO number, Tranche reference, BU code (Stonehaven internal), Cost center, Project code, Remit-to address, Tax ID. Missing any of these will cause rejections in your AP uploads.
- Net 60: we can provision Net 60 for the pilot on a case-by-case basis, but it requires sign-off from Finance and a short credit form. If Stonehaven wants Net 60 as the long-term term, we need Legal to add an amendment to the subscription agreement.

If you can confirm whether Stonehaven's ERP prefers (A) consolidated month-end statement OR (B) bi-weekly tranche invoices, we'll route the request through Finance for the Net 60 approval faster.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
